record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, factorize the shared item embedding table into item-specific 64-dimensional vectors and one jointly learned 64x128 projection, then retain unit normalization and exact zero padding. Use this same representation for history items and candidates. The lower-rank parameterization may improve statistical efficiency for sparse items without changing the 128-dimensional GRU interface. Preserve history policy, GRU topology, readout, scoring, loss and optimizer; update checkpoint loading and the predictor writer.

category_rationales.rationale: Factorize the tied item representation into 64-dimensional item vectors and a jointly learned projection to the unchanged GRU width. This may improve statistical efficiency for sparse items. Preserve unit normalization, exact zero padding, GRU topology, scoring, loss and optimizer across all four datasets.
